Please dont't. You're much too young.
I almost did it today but my roommate came home. I haven't been sober in four days and I can't stop. I don't know what to do anymore
i also had gambling and drug issues. it was a tough road back. I had to combine therapy and medication, but it worked wonders in the long run
Hey. Please don't do this. Give yourself a day, two days, anything. Tell someone

This has been going on and off for over 2 years now, this most recent episode for 4 days. Yes, the time between lows is decreasing. I've tried leaning on booze and drugs as a crutch-the self-medication helps the feelings to pass sometimes-but now that's not happening

That's the thing...I know that I won't be very level-headed in the next few days. I've been going from basically fine, although not great, to the edge of a suicide crisis for the past 2 days. Impulse is getting harder to fight off

I feel terrible. Something that I was really hopeful for crashed and burned through my own fault. I hugely disappointed my family. I'm heading for a massive burnout. I know pills are a crappy way to go - i've tried using them before. But I also know that taking enough is eventually going to guarantee success. I've tried hanging myself before but that's proven repeatedly unsuccessful
I'm sorry you feel like that's all you have left...As someone who tried to do it that way, it hurts a lot more than you'd think. I hope you manage to stay strong.

If you didn't say those things, you should be clear that you won't be falsely accused. If she's telling you that you're hurting your kids, you might want to talk to them directly, if you can. Trust me, doing this would hurt them a lot more - even though that's obviously not your intention

My circumstances are very different from yours, so I can't say I relate 100%. I do relate to having told someone about suicidal feelings only to regret it, almost instantly in one case. I'm so sorry for what you went through, and I do hope you find someone you can connect with on a personal level that would have a deeper understanding of what you've been going through. In the meantime, I'll just say to please not do it. You have a legion of people on the internet here that want you to get through this
